name: S and Y Industries, Inc.
old_description: Located in Winfield, Kansas, S and Y Industries has been one of America’s premier providers of custom electronics engineering, manufacturing and turnkey assembly services since 1984. As a family-owned, ISO-certified precision manufacturer, we strive to deliver unparalleled production consistency and efficiency with all of our premium electronics solutions.
about:
S and Y Industries is based in Winfield, Kansas. The company was founded in 1984 by Sandy Foust on the back porch of a farmhouse in Atlanta, Kansas. It remains family-owned and woman-owned, with Sandy Foust serving as CEO and her sons Dan and John Foust overseeing production and sales.

The company provides custom electronic contract manufacturing services, including printed circuit board (PCB) assembly with surface mount technology (SMT) and thru-hole processes, wire harness assembly, electro-mechanical box builds, product testing, engineering and design, and program management. Operations are housed in a 60,000-square-foot facility staffed by over 100 employees, supporting low- to mid-volume production runs.

S and Y serves customers in medical, aerospace, commercial, and industrial manufacturing sectors. Its client base includes companies requiring ITAR-compliant defense work and ISO 13485-certified medical device production.

The company emphasizes a family-like culture and a commitment to acting as an extension of its customers' operations, with a stated philosophy of delivering what customers want, when they want it. Certifications such as AS9100D, ISO 9001:2015, ISO 13485, and in-house IPC-A-610 and J-STD-001 qualified personnel underpin its quality focus.
